methods.title: Final metadata consistency
methods.failure_signature: A bounded final metadata consistency claim exceeds its exact evidence or erases a failed subject.
methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the failed subject and correct only its named dependency.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never promote a passing refusal into subject success and never replay an already-successful canonical.
methods.rollback: Keep prior frozen bytes and add a bounded correction receipt.
methods.scope_boundary: Metadata consolidation only; no domain replay.

methods.title: Literal worktree count recovery
methods.failure_signature: A derived parent path runs Git outside the owner worktree and emits a false zero file count.
methods.candidate_workaround: Use the exact known worktree for a read-only scalar Git probe.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never derive a repository root by repeated Split-Path when an exact worktree is already bound.
methods.rollback: Keep the failed wrapper and use the literal-path scalar only.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only file-count bookkeeping only; no domain or canonical replay.

methods.title: Final staged-diff whitespace recovery
methods.failure_signature: An otherwise bounded final stage includes an extra blank line at EOF and fails git diff --cached --check.
methods.candidate_workaround: Trim only the named file, retain the failed staged-diff witness and rebuild exact final self-bindings.
methods.recurrence_guard: Run the staged whitespace gate before commit and canonical; never promote the failed stage seal.
methods.rollback: Use the prior staged bytes only as retained failure evidence; preserve all proposal content.
methods.scope_boundary: One final Markdown EOF correction only; no domain or prior-stage replay.
